## Maka {{tag_name}} — Windows streaming software

- **Game capture & scenes** — display/window capture, webcam/mic, program monitor, and Go Live to Twitch, YouTube, or custom RTMP.
- **Local WHIP relay** — TabcastRelay on `127.0.0.1:38473` encodes in FFmpeg; stream keys stay in relay RAM.
- **Phone camera/mic add-on** — QR pairing, independent camera and mic, rejoin, STUN/TURN (v0.2.4+).
- **Live stream recovery** — fatal ingest errors stop immediately; network blips retry; WHIP stall watchdog; optional backup RTMP ingest.

### Windows installer

Download **[Maka-Setup-{{version}}.exe](https://github.com/n0social/maka-streaming-software/releases/download/{{tag_name}}/Maka-Setup-{{version}}.exe)** from this release, or from the site: [tabcast.live.skydav.work/download.html](https://tabcast.live.skydav.work/download.html).

**Windows SmartScreen** may warn because builds are **unsigned** until code signing is configured — choose *More info* → *Run anyway* if you trust this release.
